entities.summary: Abner Frank Dalrymple was an American left fielder in Major League Baseball who hit 43 home runs and batted .288 with 407 RBI during his 12-season career spent primarily with the Chicago White Stockings. Born in Gratiot, Wisconsin, he played for the Milwaukee Grays, White Stockings, Pittsburgh Alleghenys, and Milwaukee Brewers.
